programme.desc: The More The Merrier: Growing up with brothers and sisters makes life a little sweeter, and time spent together helps these baby animals explore and learn. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Baby Animals
programme.desc: Fresh Meat: There's no time to lie about and relax for some baby animals. If they want to avoid being someone else's prey, they have to hit the ground running. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. From a neck-wrestling weevil to a lemur mum who fights with her baby on board, Madagascar is home to some weird animals with some weird fight moves. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Australia's diverse range of creatures fight hard and weird, using the beach as their duelling ground and the outback as a boxing ring. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether it's head-bashing hippos, angry elephants or duelling lions, battles that rage here are equally epic. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Welcome to India - the home of exotic animals and vibrant warfare. Monkeys stage dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war and peacock dandies swing switchblades. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Fight Club: Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas and catch an epic giraffe battle. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Gangsters: Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal and meet a flock of finches who've developed a taste for blood. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Duck for Cover: Holiday chaos as Stu and Liv catch a pregnant red-bellied black snake at a busy resort while Mick and Adele face a lace monitor lizard. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly...
programme.desc: ...Pursuit: Tangled Terror: Messy mayhem as Stu and Liv outwit a blue tongue lizard. Jess and Dan free a trapped snake before Mick and Adele rush a python rescue fast! (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet's biggest biomass migration, as billions of sardines migrate along South Africa's east coast, each hoping to escape the jaws of hungry predators.

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Kangaroo
programme.desc: Mob Rules: Life as a kangaroo isn't just about hopping around. See how the sociable Eastern Grey kangaroos come together in 'mobs', to bond over food. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Kangaroo
programme.desc: From Pouch To Foot: Eastern Grey kangaroos are prolific breeders, but motherhood isn't easy. From predators to extreme conditions, a young joey faces a daily battle for survival. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Kangaroo
programme.desc: A Buck's Life: The drive to continue the species isn't easy for male kangaroos, as these masterful marsupials climb the social ladder and fight for their right to mate. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Rise Of Animals With David Attenborough
programme.desc: From The Seas To The Skies: To celebrate David Attenborough's 100th birthday, join him when he unravelled the rise of the vertebrates and explored their origins. (1 of 2)

programme.title: Rise Of Animals With David Attenborough
programme.desc: Dawn Of The Mammals: To celebrate David Attenborough's 100th birthday, join him when he revealed the meteoric rise of mammals from their humble origins.(2 of 2)

programme.title: In For The Kill
programme.desc: It's one of the most dramatic moments in nature - a predator claiming its prey. But how have these creatures adapted to achieve these epic feats of speed, cunning and agility?

programme.title: Deadly Australians
programme.desc: Oceans: In the depths of Australia's oceans lurks a killer crew of creatures. Discover the deadliest of them all. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Big Cat Country
programme.desc: The Next Dynasty: The MK pride faces its toughest moment yet as their matriarch and best hunter Surabi's life hangs in the balance after being gored by a buffalo. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Boss Shark
programme.desc: Boss Shark: Experts study over 100 great white sharks off New Zealand, testing speed, hunting and fearlessness to crown the alpha male in their mating race. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Boss Shark: Battle Of The Sexes
programme.desc: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, with shark specialist Dr Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: which sex reigns supreme?
